title: mise build description
description: A build description read by `mise gen` and `mise build`. Mise/Frontend/Toml.lean is the reference; this schema checks shape only.

sources.description: Files that exist before the build.

source-globs.description: Glob patterns for more sources: `*` and `?` within a path component, and `**` as a whole component for any number of directories. A wildcard does not match a leading `.`. Each pattern must match at least one file.

defaults.description: Targets built when Ninja is given none. Each names a build output or an alias.

aliases.description: Names for sets of targets, emitted as Ninja `phony` edges: `mise build -- NAME` builds the targets. A target is a source, a build output or another alias; a target with `%` stands for every source and output that matches it. No build may read an alias.

params.description: Parameter defaults, overridden by `mise build --set name=value`.

rule.description: The rules. Each gives a command that build steps run.

items.description: A rule, emitted as a Ninja `rule`.

name.description: The name a build step gives in `rule`. Rule names must be unique.

command.description: The shell command. It can use `$in`, `$out` and the build step's `vars` and `params`.

description.description: The line Ninja prints when the command runs, such as `CC $out`.

depfile.description: The command writes a depfile at `$out.d`.

restat.description: Keep an output the command leaves unchanged, so its dependants need not rebuild.

wrap.description: Run the command in mise's wrapper, which restores the old outputs when it fails.

build.description: Build steps, in any order. A step's inputs name sources and outputs of other steps; mise sorts the steps and rejects a cycle.

items.description: A build step, emitted as a Ninja `build` edge.

rule.description: The name of a rule in [[rule]].

foreach.description: A pattern with one `%`, or a list of them. The step stands for one step per source or output that matches, with `%` in its paths replaced by the matched stem. It matches sources, outputs of steps without `foreach`, and outputs of earlier `foreach` steps.

outs.description: The files the command writes, passed as `$out`.

implicit-outs.description: Further files the command writes, not passed as `$out`.

ins.description: The inputs, passed as `$in`. Each names a source or a build output. In a step without `foreach`, an input with `%` stands for every source and output that matches it, in path order.

implicit-ins.description: Further inputs, not passed as `$in`. A change to one rebuilds the step. Each names a source or a build output, and `%` works as in `ins`.

order-only.description: Files built before this step. A change to one does not rebuild the step. For a depfile rule, the generated files the command may read.

params.description: Edge variables bound to the parameters of the same name in [params].

paths.description: File paths, relative to the directory that holds mise.toml.
